map.根据径向力 Fr、轴向力 Fa 及径向/轴向载荷系数 X、Y，计算当量动载荷 P: From radial force Fr, axial force Fa and radial/axial load factors X, Y, compute equivalent dynamic load P = X·Fr + Y·Fa
map.💡 公式：P = X·Fr + Y·Fa；判断准则 Fa/Fr 与界限值 e 比: 💡 Formula: P = X·Fr + Y·Fa; decision rule: compare Fa/Fr with the limit e: if Fa/Fr ≤ e then X=1, Y=0; if Fa/Fr > e use X, Y from the bearing manual.
map.X、Y 系数需根据轴承类型和 Fa/Fr 是否超过界限值 e 查轴承手册确定: X, Y factors depend on bearing type and whether Fa/Fr exceeds the limit e; look them up in the bearing manual
map.深沟球轴承 e≈0.22~0.44，角接触球轴承 e≈0.38~0.57，圆锥滚: Deep-groove ball bearing e≈0.22~0.44, angular-contact ball bearing e≈0.38~0.57, tapered-roller bearing e≈0.4
map.角接触轴承需考虑内部轴向力，成对安装时按实际轴向合力计算: Angular-contact bearings must consider internal axial force; for paired installation use the actual combined axial force
map.📚 深度解析：滚动轴承当量动载荷计算: 📚 Deep Dive: Rolling-bearing Equivalent Dynamic Load Calculation
map.轴承载荷合成：径向力 Fr 与轴向力 Fa 按系数 X/Y 合成当量动载荷 P: Load combination: radial Fr and axial Fa combined into equivalent dynamic load P by factors X/Y
map.寿命换算：用 P 代入 L10 公式估算寿命: Life conversion: use P in the L10 formula to estimate life
map.载荷主导判断：识别径向或轴向是否为主导: Load-dominance judgment: identify whether radial or axial dominates
map.当量动载荷 P=X·Fr+Y·Fa（X 径向系数、Y 轴向系数，由 Fa/Fr: Equivalent dynamic load P=X·Fr+Y·Fa (X radial factor, Y axial factor, from Fa/Fr and e via table); when Fa/Fr>0.4 axial effect is significant, verify e and Y. Radial share=X·Fr/P, axial share=Y·Fa/P.
map.Fr=4kN、Fa=2kN、X=0.56、Y=1.5：P=0.56×4+1.5×: Fr=4kN, Fa=2kN, X=0.56, Y=1.5: P=0.56×4+1.5×2=5.24 kN, Fa/Fr=0.5 (>0.4, axial significant), radial share 42.7%, axial share 57.3%, axial is the dominant load.
map.X、Y 系数怎么取？: How to pick X, Y factors?
map.由轴承类型与 Fa/(C0·e) 查产品样本的系数表；本工具取示例值，实际须按具: From the coefficient table in the product catalog by bearing type and Fa/(C0·e); this tool uses example values — actual values must follow the specific bearing's e and coefficient table, as wrong values severely skew the life.
map.Fa/Fr 大于 0.4 意味着什么？: What does Fa/Fr greater than 0.4 mean?
map.超过 thresholds e 后轴向载荷不可忽略，须用对应的 Y 系数合成；忽: Once past the limit e, axial load cannot be ignored and the corresponding Y factor must be used for combination; ignoring axial load underestimates P and overestimates life, risking premature failure.
map.轴承当量动负荷计算器用于将同时作用的径向载荷 Fr 和轴向载荷 Fa 折算为一个: Bearing equivalent-load calculator combines the simultaneously acting radial load Fr and axial load Fa into a single equivalent dynamic load P, with P = X·Fr + Y·Fa; a necessary precursor to bearing life calculation.
map.自动计算 Fa/Fr 比值并判断载荷主导方向: Auto-compute Fa/Fr ratio and judge load direction
map.分解显示径向与轴向分量及其占比: Show radial and axial components and their shares
map.支持任意 X、Y 系数输入，适配各类轴承: Supports arbitrary X, Y inputs for all bearing types
map.判断轴向载荷是否需重点考虑: Judge whether axial load needs emphasis
